title: Lua N-API _setActorExtraStat c2s trace findings
scope: Trace whether the CharaBase Lua N-API setter _setActorExtraStat emits a client-to-server packet or rides the generic EventStartPacket path.

result.summary: _setActorExtraStat is a local CharaSubStatStorage writer in the observed evidence. It is registered into the Control::CharaBase N-API surface, but the native implementation has no direct code callers, no EventStartPacket builder/send callees, and no shipped Lua script callsite by name. The matching server-visible ExtraStat update remains the server-driven 0x0145 ChangeActorExtraStat receive/apply path.

registration.evidence: FUN_00754FE0 calls FUN_00726510(param_1, FUN_007080F0, ...) and registers the string `_setActorExtraStat` through FUN_00CCCAD0.

implementation.summary: Reads one Lua-passed value, gets the CharaSubStatStorage through FUN_006EEC00, preserves upper NetStatUser/NetStatSystem bits at SUBSTRUCT+0x10, and calls FUN_006FA980 with a low-byte ExtraStat replacement.

mergeWriter.summary: Writes SUBSTRUCT+0x10 and fires local Lua callbacks `_onChangeNetStatUser` / `_onChangeNetStatSystem` through FUN_00447260 + FUN_00CC7A90 for changed upper bits. It does not call EventStartPacket builders or the packet send gate.

eventStartCrossCheck.summary: FindAllReferences kept the EventStartPacket 0x012D builder/send surface separate from _setActorExtraStat. The EventStart builder is referenced by known event-command wrappers; _setActorExtraStat only references FUN_006FA980.

luaScriptCallsites.basis: Search of build/lua found no `_setActorExtraStat` callsites.

conclusion.interpretation: No c2s opcode is assigned for _setActorExtraStat. In the current catalog, the setter is client-local state mutation plus local Lua callback firing; authoritative/server-visible ExtraStat changes are delivered to the client by 0x0145 ChangeActorExtraStat.
